declarations.description:
A page of a `<webwriter-advance-organizer>`: the content shown when a learner clicks on
the node it belongs to. Pages are children of the advance organizer and are linked to a
node by giving them the `id` of that node.

A page holds arbitrary content – text, images, other widgets – and stays hidden until
its node is opened. Pages are managed by the advance organizer, adding a page to a node
in the toolbar creates one, and removing the node removes its page again.
declarations.name: WebwriterAdvanceOrganizerPage

declarations.description:
A visual advance organizer: a canvas of labeled boxes, connecting arrows and images
that gives learners an overview of a topic before they study it in detail.
declarations.name: WebwriterAdvanceOrganizer

slots.description: The pages of the advance organizer, as `<webwriter-advance-organizer-page>` elements.

members.description:
The nodes of the advance organizer. Each node has an `id` that edges refer to and that
links it to a page of the same `id`, a `position` and `dimension` in canvas coordinates,
a `label` and a `style`.

members.name: edges
members.default: [ { id: "e1", kind: "edge", source: "1", target: "2", sourcePosition: "left", targetPosition: "right", style: { stroke: "purple", strokeWidth: 2, strokeStyle: "dashed", markerStart: "arrow", markerEnd: "arrow", }, label: { text: "connects to", bold: true, }, }, { id: "e2", kind: "edge", source: "1", target: "3", sourcePosition: "bottom", targetPosition: "right", style: { stroke: "orange", strokeWidth: 3, strokeStyle: "dotted", markerEnd: "arrow", }, label: { text: "leads to", italic: true, }, }, { id: "e3", kind: "edge", source: "2", target: "3", sourcePosition: "bottom", targetPosition: "top", style: { stroke: "teal", strokeWidth: 1, markerEnd: "arrow", }, label: { text: "points to", underline: true, }, }, ]
members.description:
The edges of the advance organizer. Each edge refers to its `source` and `target`
node by `id`, anchored at a fixed side of the node (`sourcePosition`/`targetPosition`),
and can carry a `label` and a `style` including arrow heads at either end.

members.name: images
members.description:
The images placed on the canvas. Each image has a `position` and `dimension` in canvas
coordinates and a `src` stored as a data URL.
